TOSS-UP
7) PHYSICS Short Answer What is the name of the force that opposes the relative motion of two surfaces in contact?
ANSWER: FRICTION
BONUS
7) PHYSICS Multiple Choice Which of the following changes would increase the gravitational force between two masses?
W) Doubling the distance between them
X) Doubling one of the masses
Y) Halving one of the masses
Z) Removing the air between them
ANSWER: X) DOUBLING ONE OF THE MASSES
